repair.diagnosis: The fixed Add to Cart button is obscured by the sticky promo bar, making it unclickable
repair.evidenceSummary: Hit tests at mobile, small, and desktop all report hitIsSelf:false with hitElement sticky-promo for #add-to-cart; the button is fixed at bottom:16px with height 52px and z-index:10 while sticky-promo is fixed at bottom:0 with height 84px and z-index:20, and the mobile screenshot shows the promo at the bottom with no visible Add to Cart button. Real pointer purchase also fails.
repair.rationale: Moving the button 100px from the bottom places it 16px above the 84px-high sticky promo, preserving both elements while making the button visible and hit-testable in all viewports.

parsed.rationale: Repair correctly addresses diagnosed overlap: #add-to-cart (fixed bottom:16px, h52, z10) was obscured by sticky-promo (fixed bottom:0, h84, z20) per hitIsSelf:false at all viewports and screenshot. Moving to bottom:100px = 84px promo +16px gap makes button hit-testable with no overlap, preserving both elements. EvidenceAfter shows 3 interactive-usable failures and pointer-purchase-works fixed, no new regressions; remaining cart-total failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this UI fix.

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot and catalog show displayed price $89.00 (8900 minor), but probes show cart totals 7900 for qty 1 and 15800 for qty 2; app.js defines LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR = 7900 and multiplies count by it
repair.rationale: Derive cart total from product.priceMinor loaded from window.CATALOG, the single source of truth, without hardcoding the catalog value

parsed.rationale: Fix correctly replaces stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG, aligning cart total with displayed $89.00 (8900) for nova-sneaker. Minimal change avoids hardcoding, uses single source of truth, and is verified by deterministicProbePassAfter true and no remaining failing signals.
